The analysis failed due to significant numerical discrepancies in margin calculations and formatting errors in the summary output.
The test_rows_and_order failed with a value mismatch in panel calculations: close(369.2, 6276.4) returned False. Total margin assertions failed in test_totals_and_decision, where 26185.96 was calculated instead of the expected 1090.76. Additionally, test_summary_requirements failed because the summary text lacked required comma-formatted currency strings (e.g., '26,185.96'). Avoid incorrect aggregation logic for 14-day vs 28-day margins and ensure the final summary strictly follows the expected numeric formatting.
